About Me

I'm Rovin Singh, a blogger and content writer from Chandauli, Uttar Pradesh. My journey into the world of competitive exams began in 2017 when I started writing about news and digital content. What started as curiosity soon became a mission to help fellow aspirants.

After years of preparation for SSC, Railway, and State Police examinations, I cleared SSC GD 2018 and joined the Border Security Force. I served for a year before leaving due to personal reasons — but that experience taught me invaluable lessons about discipline, consistency, and mental resilience.

Today, I run Sarkari Job, where I publish authentic job notifications, exam updates, syllabus breakdowns, and preparation strategies. You can find all my published articles on my author page. My content is written from an aspirant's perspective — because I've walked that path myself.
